fonts.display: 'Times Now', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Founders Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cream Paper
palette.role: Page background, nav surface, warm canvas base

palette.name: Soft Linen
palette.role: Card surface, slightly brighter than canvas for subtle elevation

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, borders, icons — near-black with a subtle green undertone that warms the entire palette

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Button text on filled terracotta, pure white highlights

palette.name: Warm Sand
palette.role: Muted section dividers, secondary card backgrounds, beige illustration fills

palette.name: Olive Grove
palette.role: Hero panel background, dark accent surface — earthy green-black anchors the brand and gives the chartreuse somewhere to glow

palette.name: Chartreuse Spark
palette.role: Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Terracotta CTA
palette.role: Orange action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Coral Outline
palette.role: Outlined/ghost CTA variant, secondary action borders — a deeper, redder cousin of terracotta for outlined button treatment

palette.name: Deep Olive
palette.role: Input field text, deepest green-black for hairline borders on dark surfaces
